title: Evaluating with Con lo que and Para lo que
goal: Evaluate results and benchmarks with *con lo (adj/adv) que* and *para lo (adj/adv) que*

items: I can express surprise or complaint with *con lo* + adjective/adverb + *que* and *con lo que*.
I can set an evaluative benchmark with *para lo* + adjective/adverb + *que* and *para lo que*.
I can keep adjective agreement and the indicative accurate in everyday evaluative speech.
